title: koenigia alpina var. stewartii
intro: Koenigia alpina var. stewartii, commonly known as Himalayan Knotweed, is a plant species within the Polygonaceae family, native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce blood pressure, and possess antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Koenigia alpina var. stewartii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
